description: Luminarias de Tecnología. Bogotá D.C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. En este Data Set encontrará el resumen general de los Datos de las luminarias de Tecnología de la ciudad de Bogotá años 2017 -2018 -2019. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. Its tags are LOCALIDAD, Luminarias Tecnologia Fluorescente, Luminarias Tecnologia Halogenuros Metalicos, Luminarias Tecnologia LED, Luminarias Tecnologia SODIO. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2020-08-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
